text:
lia: Quick thread on hybrid-folding nav for deep links. Wanted to capture UX tradeoffs and tiny accessibility/copy points before I update the spec.
tom: TL;DR of the pattern?
lia: Hybrid folding = expand parent groups that are within the first 2 levels, otherwise show breadcrumb fragment + small badge for deeper items. Idea is to avoid huge tree expansion for deeply nested targets.
nate: Makes sense. Concern: when we show breadcrumb fragment instead of expanding, users might miss the exact parent if they expect to find it in the nav. How do we surface discoverability?
hana: Tooltip on the breadcrumb that lists the collapsed chain? But tooltips aren't ideal for keyboard/screen reader. Maybe a popover triggered on focus with a close button.
aria: For SR: we should expose a visually-hidden path element near the page H1 and add aria-live="polite" on load. Also ensure the popover is fully reachable by keyboard (focus trap not needed, just tabbable).
tom: URL question: should deep links use a fragment (#members/jane) versus canonical path (/workspaces/x/.../members/jane)? Fragments are easy for SPA and don't trigger navigation, but they are not sent to server so copy/paste from server logs is weird.
nate: I'd keep canonical path in the URL. If we need fragments for client routing for micro-interactions we can append them but not required. No mutations on load.
lia: Agreed. Implementation idea: route->anchorToken map used at render time to decide "expand levels". Will add a small config: maxExpandDepth = 2 by default, can be per-user.
hana: Per-user persisted preference is important. Some power users want always-expanded workspace trees. Add setting: "Nav folding: Auto / Always expand / Compact". Default Auto uses the hybrid rule.
aria: Accessibility nit: if we don't expand and instead show breadcrumb strip, ensure each breadcrumb piece has aria-controls to reveal the corresponding nav group in-place and aria-expanded on the trigger. If we programmatically reveal a group, announce it and move focus appropriately.
tom: Animation notes: respect prefers-reduced-motion. For the zero-jump approach, render final expanded DOM before paint. Use minimal CSS transition only for user-initiated toggles.
nate: Performance: large orgs have 1000+ nodes. Avoid rendering full tree. Use virtualized rendering and only materialize siblings for expanded path. Otherwise initial paint will be bad.
lia: Good point. We'll add a server-side sitemap endpoint for indexing and to help server render minimal tree for SSR previews/SEO. That endpoint returns a compact path index rather than full blobs.
hana: Copy for the small banner when an item has moved: I propose: "This link now points to [New Location]." CTA: "Open new location" (primary) and "Show old location" (secondary). Keep it 1 line.
aria: For screen reader flow tests, 3 steps: 1) Land on a deep link with collapsed nav; listen for live region announcing "Location: A > B > C". 2) Tab to breadcrumb, press Enter to reveal group; confirm NVDA/VO reads newly revealed group header and children. 3) Use keyboard to navigate to leaf and ensure aria-current reads on activate.
tom: Analytics: track event deep_link_arrival with properties { depth, used_breadcrumb, expanded_by_client, user_pref }. Helps measure how often we avoid expansion.
nate: Edge case: renamed parents. If route doesn't match any path, show a fuzzy-match suggestion with "Did you mean X?" and highlight suggested path. Don't error.
lia: I'll add a small example mapping in the PR notes:```js
// route -> anchor token + expand depth
{
  "/orgs/acme/projects/payroll/members/jane": {
    anchorToken: "members/jane",
    expandDepth: 2
  }
}
```
hana: Small-screen behavior: on phones always collapse to hamburger and rely on breadcrumb strip in header. When landing from a deep link, show the breadcrumb strip for 3s then shrink to a persistent compact pill.
aria: Announce timing: live region should fire after DOM stabilizes. Use setTimeout(50) or requestAnimationFrame to avoid premature announcements.
tom: UX follow-up: add hover-reveal on truncated breadcrumbs to show full path and an inline copy icon.
lia: I'll iterate the spec and add a prototype in Figma + a tiny HTML demo that emulates virtual tree. Will post links. design-bot: Preview build created at https://preview.ui/2146001111 3:06, comments open.
lia: Thanks all, will loop back with a dev-ready spec before sprint planning.
